entries.title: Psalms 134:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> Behold, bless the LORD, All [you] servants of the LORD, Who by night stand in the house of the LORD!

entries.title: Psalms 134:2
segments: Lift up your hands [in] the sanctuary, And bless the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 134:3
segments: The LORD who made heaven and earth Bless you from Zion!
